article_summary: This article describes a cooperative photoredox and N-heterocyclic carbene (NHC) catalysis method for the regioselective sp2 C-H aroylation of di- and trisubstituted allenes. The reaction utilizes 4CzIPN as an organic photocatalyst and triazolium-based NHCs to couple allenes with aroyl fluorides or chlorides, proceeding via an allene radical cation intermediate trapped by benzoate and subsequent cross-coupling with an NHC-derived ketyl radical.
